conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced turned up. FY26 is effectively pre-released: the July 15 cut set OP at 2,373, IFIS consensus sits on it at 2,370, and no revision has been filed since. So the print turns on two decisions nobody outside can see yet: the FY27 guide and the FY27 dividend. On the guide, deferred volumes plus a Dec-18 Pokemon art book lean up. On the dividend, the 40% payout policy sits against a 44-yen dividend that is 56% of EPS, which leans to a cut or to 未定. Every one of this name's four 16:00 prints since the IPO fell the next day (-6.1, -9.8, -2.5, -13.8), and margin longs outnumber margin shorts 655 to 1, so p_up is set slightly under 50 (46) on a scale of 8%. impact_sum is -0.5. The two numbers agree in sign and size.
bar: FY2026/8 company plan after the 2026-07-15 revision: revenue 8,300, OP 2,373, pretax 2,122, NP 1,566 (JPY m), dividend 44 yen (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594128.pdf). IFIS consensus is OP 2,370 / pretax 2,100 / NP 1,560 (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=414A), so two sources agree on FY26. No FY27 consensus and no target price is published (IFIS shows none), so the FY27 guide bar is unsourced and the guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed, unchanged (baseline, as of 2026-10-14, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 655x (baseline; kabutan header 2026-10-15). irbank's last free row (07/17) shows a margin long of 581,600 shares against 4,600 short (https://irbank.net/414A/margin). That is about 15-20 sessions of the current ~30k-shares/day turnover, so leveraged retail is crowded long. There is no squeeze fuel. No options, so no skew. priced_lean_pct is -1.30, almost all of it margin overhang.

findings.finding: The FY26 plan needs a Q4 (Jun-Aug) OP of 677 against 496 in Q3 (+36% q/q) and 933 a year ago, on revenue of 2,243 (Pokemon 全国図鑑 shipped 8/7, delayed volumes). The company's only prior post-period forecast (2025-10-03, OP 3,144, made after the FY had closed) printed 3.8% lower at 3,026. A miss of a few percent sits below the TSE ±30% revision threshold, so it could still be undisclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 (7/15, plan cut 31%) -13.8% next day. FY25 print (2025-10-15, actual slightly under the 10/03 forecast, new record guide) -6.1% next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Anyone can compute the Q4 requirement from the Q3 短信, and consensus already sits a hair under the plan (pretax 2,100 against 2,122). What is not public is whether book returns and e-book sales hit the July estimate. If the market expected a miss, the IFIS number would sit visibly below 2,122, and it does not.
findings.independence: Q3 presentation p.9 and pp.23-25 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594140.pdf) give the quarterly table and the Q4 drivers. It is the same company data, so not independent.

findings.finding: The dividend policy is a 40% payout (changed from 35%+ on 2025-10-15, applying from FY26). The FY26 dividend of 44 yen, held through the July cut 'considering funding needs', is 56% of revised EPS 78.21. At 40%, FY27 would need EPS of about 110 (+40%) to keep 44 yen. At the last full-year print the following year's dividend was left 未定 and only set at Q2. So the release is more likely to carry a lower FY27 dividend or 未定 than a held 44 yen, on a stock trading at a 5.4% yield.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 (2026-04-14): FY26 dividend first set at 44 yen (+7.8 yen) alongside H1 NP +4%; the stock fell 2.5% the next day. FY25 print, when the FY26 dividend was left 未定: -6.1% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Yield screens and kabuyoho still show a 5.40% forecast yield on the 44-yen FY26 dividend. The 44 yen is ex since 8/28 (the stock fell 5.6% that day). If the market expected a FY27 cut to about 30-36 yen, the stock would trade near that forward yield rather than on the trailing 44. The run-up of -2.2% over 20 days shows no sign of that repricing.
findings.independence: The 2026-04-14 dividend notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260414/140120260414503819.pdf) restates the 40% target. The July revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594128.pdf) holds 44 yen despite the cut. All three are company documents.

findings.finding: The company has said the FY26 shortfall partly moves into FY27: delayed popular volumes and anime timing are '来期売上寄与', the Comic Garde cycle 'stabilises from Q4', and Q3 brought 53 new light-novel IPs against 31 a year earlier. A three-volume, ~1,500-page Pokemon 30th-anniversary art book launches 2026-12-18, inside FY27 Q2. That points to a FY27 guide showing a profit recovery from a depressed base, on a stock priced at PER ~10.5 on falling earnings. Investment costs (editors, manga fees, visual-novel game development) continue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: One prior new-year guide (FY25 print, NP +8% and a 4th record): -6.1% the next day, during the post-IPO de-rating. That guide was later cut 30%, so management's credibility is low and a growth guide may be discounted.
findings.why_not_priced: No FY27 consensus is published (IFIS shows FY26 only, no target, no rating), and the stock sits 40% below its 1,345 debut price at PER 10.5 and PBR 1.9. That is the price of a no-growth view. If the market expected a recovery guide, the multiple would not sit at a cyclical trough with the stock below its post-cut 7/16 rebound high.
findings.independence: The art-book date comes from a separate company release (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260916/140120260916536990.pdf, 2026-09-16), but it is the same issuer. No independent analyst source exists.

findings.finding: Margin longs are crowded with almost no shorts (信用倍率 655x; margin long 581,600 shares against 4,600 short at 07/17, about 3% of shares and roughly 15-20 days of current turnover). The stock has fallen the next day after all four post-IPO 16:00 prints, so a disappointing item has ready leveraged sellers and a good one meets supply into strength.

findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The baseline's priced_lean_pct of -1.30 already carries margin overhang, so this is kept small. It is filed because it sets the asymmetry of the reaction, not because the market has missed it.

findings.finding: Kaikai Kiki (Takashi Murakami's company) built a pure-investment stake: 5.02% on 2026-09-01, raised to 6.08% (1,217,100 shares) on 2026-09-11. That is a buyer on the register that may add on weakness after the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The filings moved the stock +4.4% (9/3) and lifted it about 4% over three sessions into 9/16. All of that has since been given back (874 to 816).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stake is public and the pop has faded. The residual is only that a known accumulator caps the downside of a sell-off.

outside_window.finding: Pokemon visual art book (three volumes) launches 2026-12-18. Its revenue lands in FY27 Q2, not in this print, beyond whatever the FY27 guide embeds.

release_time_source: Precedent, not a dated notice for this print. The FY25, Q1 and Q2 決算短信 were stamped 16:00 and Q3 at 16:30 on TDnet via kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=414A). Either way the release is after the 15:30 close, so the window is the 10-15 close to the 10-16 close.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: FY26 was already cut 2026-07-15 and nothing has followed, so FY26 lands near plan (consensus = plan). Returns: the FY27 dividend is the live item; the 40% payout policy against the 44-yen (56%) FY26 dividend leans to a cut or 未定, and no buyback history exists. New-year guide: the main event, with no FY27 consensus published and inferred tailwinds from deferred volumes and the Dec art book. Quarter vs own 進捗率: 9M OP progress is 71.5% of plan against 69.2% at 9M FY25 (2,093/3,026), so it is not visibly behind its own seasonality.
baseline_tension: The findings agree with the margin-overhang lean (-1.30) and the slight negative run-up (-2.2% over 20 days). The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY27 guide showing profit growth together with a held 44-yen dividend. I looked for it: the deferred volumes and the art book support the first, the payout policy argues against the second, and no FY27 bar exists to judge either. So the net lean is small and p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1, a negative resting on a series the market already has: the Q4-requirement finding is computable from the Q3 短信, so it moved from -0.4 to -0.2. The dividend finding was left at -0.8 because it is an item the release ADDS (a dividend decision), which the rule exempts.

Rule 2, negatives outnumber positives (3 against 2): I wrote the strongest positive (a growth guide plus a held 44 yen) into baseline_tension, having looked for it, and moved p_up from 44 to 46. expected_move moves from -0.96 to -0.64.
The positioning finding was left at -0.5: it already agrees with the baseline lean and was sized small in the draft.
